observations: Photo 0: Front view of a grey chest deep freezer with a DIGITREX brand label and an energy label showing model DX150. The top edge shows some white residue or damage.

Photo 1: Interior view with lid open, showing a white plastic basket on the right, a small container with ice or frozen items on the left, and a lit interior light. The interior walls are textured with frost or condensation.

Photo 2: Rear view showing the back panel with a vent, power socket, and a white power cord plugged into a wall outlet. The top edge has white residue or damage, similar to photo 0. The freezer is on a marble-patterned floor.
